raw_definitions: Definisi : vi a. produce undeveloped branches, leaves, bertunas; b. produce undeveloped flowers, mengeluarkan kudup: the rose bushes are ~ding, pohon mawar itu mengeluarkan kudup; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : nip st in the ~, (fig.) menghentikan sst dr awal-awal lagi; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. rudimentary growth of, a. (branch, leaf) tunas: ~ grafting, cantuman tunas; b. (of flower) kudup; in ~, a. producing undeveloped branches or leaves, sedang bertunas; b. producing undeveloped flowers, mengeluarkan kudup; 2. partially opened flower, kuntum; 3. any bud-like growth, tunas: taste ~, tunas rasa; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
